titulo: Om Shanti Shanti Shanti, on a Wednesday
caption:
Om Shanti Shanti Shanti. Peace three times: from your own body and mind, from what you can’t control, and from other beings.
Cella is still working on number three.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#omshanti #mantra #peace

alt.1: lavender field, Cella saying “Me? Very calm.” in a speech bubble. Om Shanti Shanti Shanti. Why ask for peace three times? Because there are three things ruining it.
alt.2: dark blue field at night, a pale yellow Cella wide awake next to a clock, saying “Wait. In 2014…”. Shanti: one: peace from your own body and mind. 2 a.m. Your brain replays something you said in 2014.
alt.3: blue field, a white cloud on the right, a pale yellow Cella looking up at it and saying “Rude, sky.”. Shanti: two: peace from what you can’t control. Flight delayed three hours. You yelled at the sky.
alt.4: coral field, a wall on the right with “BZZZZZT” coming through it, Cella with her eyes shut on the left. Shanti: three: peace from other beings. Saturday, 8 a.m. The neighbor found his drill.
alt.5: the three peaces as a list. Om Shanti Shanti Shanti, three peaces: Send it to the neighbor. The one with the drill. 1. One · from your own head. 2. Two · from the sky, the traffic, the airline. 3. Three · from everyone else.
